card.name: Small linking words in dosing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as every, of, a, an, taken or maintain in dosing and treatment instructions, right before a time interval or a clinical purpose.

modes.label: Interval word after a dose
modes.description: The word every after an amount such as a teaspoonful, before an hour range.
modes.example: Adults 1 teaspoonful (5 mL)<< every>> 4 to 6 hours, not

modes.label: Purpose or role linker
modes.description: A or an after as, introducing a drug's use such as sedative or adjunct.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION For symptomatic relief of anxiety and tension associated with psychoneurosis and as<< an>> adjunct in organic disease states in which anxiety

modes.label: Overdose care verbs and of
modes.description: Of or maintain in supportive-care lists before airway or treatment targets.
modes.example: Supportive measures include maintenance<< of>> an adequate airway, monitoring urinary output
